effects.effect: Your expertise with weapons has grown to true mastery. Whenever you use a signature ability from one of your equipped kits or make a [free strike](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.common.main-actions/free-strike) using a weapon from one of your equipped kits, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on the power roll. You can still roll to determine if you score a critical hit.
